name: Riverpaw Gnoll Bounty
summary: In western Elwynn, Riverpaw Gnoll Bounty calls for help against gnolls pressing the border. Deputy Rainer offers a reward at Westbrook Garrison for painted armbands taken from Riverpaw packs in the woods and by the water.

sections.title: A Threat on the Border
sections.body: Westbrook Garrison guards Elwynn Forest's border with Westfall. Its depleted forces struggle to contain the growing Riverpaw presence. The gnolls camp south of the guard tower and farther east around Stone Cairn Lake. From those camps, they threaten travelers and nearby homesteads.

sections.title: The Price of Order
sections.body: Deputy Rainer cannot spare regular infantry to sweep the woods, so he offers a bounty on the raiders. He requires painted armbands from slain gnolls as proof of each kill. Wandering adventurers and recruits are hired to thin the pack before the Riverpaws overrun the western marches.

faq.q: Where can Riverpaw gnolls be found in Elwynn Forest?
faq.answer: Riverpaw gnolls gather in two parts of Elwynn. Look in the woods south of Westbrook Garrison near the riverbanks, and farther east around Stone Cairn Lake.

faq.q: Why is the garrison asking adventurers for help with gnolls?
faq.answer: Westbrook Garrison is understaffed and pressed along Elwynn's borders. With too few guards to patrol and sweep the woods, Deputy Rainer asks independent champions to hunt the gnolls.

faq.q: What proof does Deputy Rainer require?
faq.answer: Deputy Rainer requires eight Painted Gnoll Armbands as proof that the gnolls have been killed.
The Riverpaws are a vicious tribe of hyena-like humanoids that infest river valleys and borders across human lands. They raid settlements, travelers, and farmlands for food and plunder.

faq.q: Does this quest connect to any other threats in Elwynn?
faq.answer: The bounty concludes the short Westbrook Garrison alert chain. Deputy Rainer and the garrison also watch for other lawless threats in the area, including the outlaw Hogger.

faq.q: Who pays the bounty for these gnolls?
faq.answer: The Stormwind Army backs and authorizes the bounty. It allows local garrisons to commend and compensate those who help pacify royal territories.

angles.text: As a human, you help protect Elwynn's frontiers by hunting Riverpaws and supporting the overextended crown guards.
As an Alliance member, you build standing with the Stormwind Army by taking border bounties and help secure trade routes through the heart of the kingdom.
